device.model: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz, ai-worker cpus=2 mem_limit=4294967296 (docker compose)

notes: ADR 0019. whisper-cli in the hardened ai-worker service (read-only root, no capabilities, internal network, compose limits), on about a minute of synthetic Arabic speech from espeak-ng (no real material). Peak memory is the highest container usage sampled by docker stats every 0.5 s. Accuracy is not measured here (synthetic voice); that belongs to tools/asr-bench. Output words are few because espeak-ng Arabic is hard to recognise: decoding may end earlier than on real speech, so wall time and real-time factor are a lower bound for this model on 2 vCPUs.
